render_engine.name: Calibre ebook-convert
render_engine.output: temporary PDF rendering for QA; not a release artifact

representative_pages.coverage: EPUB navigation and linked table of contents
title, credits, licensing, visible partial-scope disclosure, and first chapter transition
Marathi prose, proof blocks, inline and display mathematics, and footnote link
chapter transition, Hilbert's Hotel diagram, citation, prose, and mathematical definition
sequent-calculus proof-step tables, source placeholders, and inference symbols
dense symbolic exercise list and natural-deduction notation
tableau prose and multirow semantic proof tables

compatibility_repair.problem: The first Calibre rendering exposed unresolved fragment targets for colon-bearing source IDs.
compatibility_repair.resolution: All 861 source IDs are covered by a deterministic crosswalk; 415 unsafe IDs are remapped to ASCII IDs and all 293 source fragment links are rewritten.
compatibility_repair.result: The final Calibre conversion completed without unresolved-anchor messages.

limitations: This is representative visual inspection in one independent reading engine, not exhaustive testing in every EPUB reader.
Automated and representative visual checks do not constitute independent human linguistic or accessibility certification.
